============================
Empty prefixes
============================
b c
---
(source_file (optional_prefix) (repeated_prefix))

============================
Consuming prefixes
============================
ab aaaac
---
(source_file (optional_prefix) (repeated_prefix))

============================
Empty delimited content
============================
``
---
(source_file (raw_content))

============================
Consuming delimited content
============================
`content`
---
(source_file (raw_content))

============================
Empty comment content
============================
//
---
(source_file (line_content))

============================
Consuming recursive suffix
============================
[yxx]
---
(source_file (list (list)))

============================
Consuming generated-name collision
============================
{onetwo b c}
---
(source_file (source_file_repeat1 (optional_prefix) (repeated_prefix)))

============================
Consuming comment content
============================
// content
---
(source_file (line_content))
